text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder how it'll go~
Bubble aiming to be the first in history to win consecutive Tenno Sho (Autumn) titles!
I seriously can't wait for the race...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh, whether Bubble or Air Groove wins, it'll be a historic achievement...!
It's bound to be a legendary race...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“......I know this isn't the best time, but...
Just one question.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer,
do you think I'm a strong Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then do you think she's the strongest Umamusume,
with unprecedented power that could turn
the racing world upside down?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that moment, countless thoughts raced through my head, preventing an immediate answer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Bubble Gum Fellow is undeniably strong. Having achieved a historic first, she is undoubtedly one of the titans representing this era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that strength is far from its peak.
She should still be halfway along her journey.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I can't say for sure
if that's really who I am yet either."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this point is surely a realm
that cannot be unlocked without grasping something new—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And... I feel like I'll be able to grasp whatever that is in today's Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: Could it be... Air Groove holds the clue?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If there was a chance to grasp something today, I couldn't think of any stronger catalyst than Air Groove herself, competing on the verge of a historic achievement."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Probably, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, Trainer.
My showdown with Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'm heading out now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —So you've come.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (She's gotten even stronger since summer camp...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I will dare to say this.
Today, I am the one challenging you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And let it be engraved.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That the "Empress"
is the name of the ultimate challenger.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Gladly, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'll teach you this one, too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I am the one who fosters dreams—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Today, she is the Umamusume who will face you head-on
and carve open brand new possibilities!!
